self_sha256_note: This preregistration JSON deliberately does NOT embed its own SHA256 to avoid a self-reference paradox. The external SHA256 is recorded by the run report and the harness result JSON.
preregistered_before_metrics: This file is written before any new per-sample or aggregate spatial-target audit metric is computed.

frozen_spatial_targets.grounding_area_target: for each cell, exact intersection area with bbox_1000 clipped to [0,1000]; divide by total intersection area so mass sums to 1; hard-fail invalid or zero-area boxes
frozen_spatial_targets.pointing_bilinear_target: u=x*W/1000-0.5, v=y*H/1000-0.5; clamp to [0,W-1]x[0,H-1]; distribute mass to the up to four neighboring grid centers with separable bilinear weights; combine duplicate boundary indices; normalize to sum 1; no Gaussian, no bandwidth parameter

split_rule.val_test_action: never resolved, hashed, opened or scored

metrics.semantic_spatial_compatibility: Spearman and full NDCG (K=G, relevance=teacher_soft_target) between each spatial target and the cached semantic teacher target, per task and overall
metrics.anchor_baseline: evaluation.hardware_regular_token_selector.select_real_groups exactly, with L2 saliency as the ranking score; NOT_COMPUTED if the module cannot be imported

statistics.multiple_comparison_policy: single pre-registered family (JS and TV); raw two-sided p-values; no Holm correction invented

decision_labels.SPATIAL_SUPERVISION_SIGNAL_PRESENT: all integrity checks pass AND 95% bootstrap CI lower bound of spatial-semantic is greater than zero for BOTH JS and TV; top-K results are descriptive only and cannot override this rule
decision_labels.BLOCKED_DATA_CONTRACT: joins, geometry, grid or isolation contracts fail
decision_labels.learnability_caveat: even when signal is present, learnability and downstream task accuracy remain untested

prohibitions: no optimizer, no training, no parameter update, no new Wt/Wv, no checkpoint
no 4B model load, no inference, no GPU, no network, no package installation
no reading, resolving, hashing or scoring of val/test NPZ files
no reading of raw image bytes, model weights, keys, proxy files or credentials
no blending of the spatial targets with the semantic teacher
no formula tuning after seeing metrics
no multiple-candidate search, no Holm correction invented
no claim that a student can learn the target, no claim that downstream accuracy improves, no FPGA speedup claim
immutability_rule: All six pinned inputs and this preregistration pair are byte-for-byte unchanged before and after the audit run; the run report records the pre-run and post-run SHA256 of every pinned input.
authorization: DeepSeek Harness may process necessary code, metrics and derived data via api.deepseek.com; raw images, 4B weights, keys, proxy config and credentials are never read, uploaded or printed.
